notes.title: 【Known Issue】Mac version unable to use Steam Cloud Save
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p]We’ve identified a problem where [b]Steam Cloud Save is currently not working on the Mac version[/b] of the game. This means your progress [b]won’t sync[/b] to the cloud and may be lost if switching devices.[/p][p]We have located the issue and are [b]actively working on a fix[/b]. In the meantime, we recommend:[/p][list][*][p][b]Avoid switching devices[/b] while playing on Mac.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Manually back up your save files[/b] regularly.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll post an update as soon as the issue is resolved. Thank you for your patience and support![/p][p]—The [i]This Month’s Stay: Hotel Tycoon[/i] Dev Team[/p]
